_readme: Edit this file to change the AI Gigs page. 'referral' = your referral link for that platform (leave empty to use 'site'). 'feeds' = public job boards the updater reads every 8 hours (types: ashby, greenhouse, lever). 'socials' = your accounts; empty ones are hidden on the page.
